summary: The ProfileHistory component is a part of the HSPnet system designed to handle and display staff profile history. It interacts with user sessions, staff data, and provides a user interface for filtering and displaying different sections of staff history.
purpose: To manage and display different sections of a staff member's profile history within the HSPnet system.

workflows.name: DataBinding Workflow
steps: Check if UserSession is not null.
Create StaffPRHistoryList with UserSession and StaffID.
Determine the screen section from the selected DropDownList item.
Set lblScreenSection text with section label.
Check for existence of data entries and add respective items to DropDownList.
Set GridData source based on selected screenSection and bind the data.

business_rules: DropDownList ddScreenSection is populated based on available data types.
validations: Check if UserSession is not null before proceeding.
Validate screenSection value to decide data filtering logic.
conditions: If selected screenSection is 'ALL', all data entries are displayed.
Otherwise, filter data entries by the specified screenSection.
system_behavior: Populates user interface elements with relevant data sections based on user selection.
Ensures interface updates accurately reflect data state.
